label: 2. Have no fear, Laplace is here!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Have no fear, Laplace is here!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Run for your lives, Drake has arrived!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Do you two ever shut up?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'm trying to concentrate.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: But we're only texting...

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: That doesn't make you any less irritating!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Well, excuuuuuse me.
Anyway, what brings you two here?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Don't forget that I got here first!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Laplace is the one who followed me!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How about we see a movie together?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: What kind of movie?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How about a superhero movie?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I heard a great new installment just came out.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I've gotta see if the hero in the film is cooler than me or not.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Not interested.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Any movies about scientists trying to save the world?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: A superhero movie?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Who's the protagonist?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Are they a villain?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Of course not! The hero is always the main character in a superhero movie.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: There's bound to be a villain as well.
What other characters show up?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Let's see... There's a mad scientist who is obsessed with his crazy experiments

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: and hell-bent on destroying the world.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Then there's another villain who's a real ignoramus!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: The plot has to do with the main hero saving the world from these dastardly villains!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: He wants to destroy the entire world?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: No thanks, I can't stand violent movies.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Why is it that every time a scientist shows up in a movie,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: they're insane, want to destroy the world, or both?
Hahaha!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: C'mon guys, I can't go see the movie on my own!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: But the characters and the story sound so predictable.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Sorry, not interested.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'll be off doing experiments,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: so I'll be incommunicado.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How about you Drake? Care to join me?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: A supervillain attempting to destroy the world?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Sounds kind of intense...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I'm afraid I can't join you.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Fine...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: What about you, Birdie?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Do me this favor, will you?
No, thanks.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Turned down not once, not twice... but three times...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: This is quite the blow to my dignity...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Fine then, I'll go see the movie by myself!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hahaha!
Why are you laughing, Drake?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Are you laughing at me?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: No, it's just that your laughter is infectious.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Gotcha. Well, I'm gonna head to the theater. Bye.
